profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation that develops and distributes Blender, a free 3D creation software suite covering modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, camera and object tracking, Grease Pencil drawing, and VFX work. The foundation describes its software as production-ready and notes it is used in short films, advertisements, TV series, and feature films. Blender 5.2 LTS is the current release, introducing features such as a Cycles Texture Cache for more memory-efficient rendering of scenes with many image textures, new Grease Pencil texture brushes, and an Online Essentials Asset Library. Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, the Linux Foundation, and OIN, and the foundation describes hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks a category of community and third-party offerings called Blender AI Add-ons, described as 3D creation AI plugins that are open-source and perform local processing, with model provenance varying by plugin. Blender's core software also exposes a Python API that allows developers to build and distribute add-ons, forming what the foundation describes as an ever-expanding ecosystem of tutorial makers, content creators, add-on developers, and global marketplaces. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings appear in the available data.
